title: D2NET-Settings.json (PGLite)
description: Authoritative shape of .D2NET/D2NET-Settings.json after the storage swap to PGLite WASM. Diff from shipped 002: connection.engine is 'pglite'; connection.host/port/database/user/password/data_dir are added; connection.db_file is removed; connection.connection_string is now an Npgsql string; connection.connection_string_odbc is added (Q5 clarification).

excluded_directories.description: Sorted ascending lexicographically; one entry per approved excluded directory (relative to source_dir, forward-slash).

password.description: Placeholder credential; not a security boundary.

data_dir.description: Absolute path to the PGLite data tree (.D2NET/pgdb/). Diagnostic / disaster-recovery use only; clients connect via the wire protocol.

connection_string.description: Npgsql/.NET-style connection string. SSL Mode=Disable matches bridge-direct.mjs, which replies 'N' to SSLRequest.

connection_string_odbc.description: psqlODBC-style connection string for Windows hosts with the modern PostgreSQL ODBC Driver(UNICODE) installer. Users on other ODBC variants edit the Driver={...} clause manually.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp recorded when the fresh-init run completed; not modified by --FORCE --DELETE-EXISTING re-init (which writes its own fresh value).
